abilities.name: Reaper's Mark
abilities.description: Basic Attacks cleave in an area in front of Malthael and afflict non-Structure targets with Reaper's Mark for 4 seconds. Marked enemies are revealed and take damage equal to 2% of their maximum Health every 1 second.

fields.props: Attack Modifier, Damage over Time, Percent damage, Revealed, Splash
fields.notes: If Multiple Malthaels are on a team, they each apply and refresh their own Mark separately. However, the effects of all Reaper's Marks are shared: the damage does not stack, and all Malthaels can interact with a target that has Reaper's Mark regardless of whether or not they own a mark on the target.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.description: Extract the souls of nearby enemies afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 100 damage and healing Malthael for 25 per target hit. Heroic targets heal Malthael for an additional 4% of the Hero's maximum Health.

fields.notes: Can only be activated if there is at least one enemy affected by Reaper's Mark within the Ability's radius. Healing from each target is dealt in a separate instance, and bonus healing from Heroes is dealt in yet another instance, separate from the base heal.

abilities.name: Wraith Strike
abilities.description: Instantly teleport through an enemy afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 59 damage and refreshing Reaper's Mark.

fields.notes: Can only be activated if there is at least one enemy affected by Reaper's Mark. Malthael teleports to the opposite side of the target from his location at 1.5 distance. Puts Malthael's Basic Attack on full cooldown (1.1s) without using it upon activation.

abilities.name: Death Shroud
abilities.description: After 0.25 seconds, unleash a wave of dark mist that applies Reaper's Mark to enemies it hits.

abilities.name: Tormented Souls
abilities.description: Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana and its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.; 60; 20; heroic

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.description: Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health. Repeatable Quest Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.; 70; 100; heroic

fields.notes: Mathematically, kills a target which is at less than or equal to 1/3 of maximum Health. Damage is based on missing Health when the Mark expires after 2 seconds. The Mark cannot be removed, but the damage can be avoided with effects that grant damage immunity, like entering the Hall of Storms, or entering Stasis or Invulnerability, at the time of its expiration. While Last Rites is available, enemy Heroes within 12 radius of Malthael are indicated by a red skull above them if the damage from Last Rites would be enough to kill them.

talents.description: Increase Wraith Strike's range by 35%.

talents.description: Soul Rip deals 50% more damage if it hits only one Hero.

fields.notes: If any number of non-Heroic targets are also hit, the bonus damage still applies, but only to the Hero.

talents.name: Throwing Shade
talents.description: Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30. Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.
_raw_fields: Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30. Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.

talents.name: Black Harvest
talents.description: Quest Apply Reaper's Mark to Heroes for a total of 150 seconds. Permanently increase Reaper's Mark 's duration by 2 seconds.

fields.notes: If multiple Malthaels are in a team, Black Harvest starts to gain stacks only when the Hero with the Talent has applied a Reaper's Mark to the enemy Hero. However, once applied it continues to gain stacks even after the Hero's personal mark has expired, as long as the target is afflicted by any Reaper's Mark.

fields.notes: Affects all active Reaper's Marks, including those placed by other Malthaels. Healing reduction stacks additively with other healing modifiers that can affect the healing received by the target Hero.
